newsitem.title: USA: Pep Boys issues notes worth $130.8 mln gross.
newsitem.headline: Pep Boys issues notes worth $130.8 mln gross.

text.p: Pep Boys - Manny, Moe & Jack said on Tuesday it issued four percent liquid yield option notes due September 1, 2001, with gross proceeds estimated at $130.8 million.
Pep Boys would use proceeds to repay short-term variable rate bank debt and part of its long-term variable rate debt.

Pep Boys said in a statement the LYONs were convertible into its common stock at any time, at an initial conversion price of $42.70 per share. It said it had granted underwriter Merrill Lynch & Co an option to buy an additional $19.2 million in notes to cover over-allotments.
